confirmation_source: Owner approval in session 2026-11-13 (Olivier Winter, repository and scientific owner): neutral Linear/Full display with the range at the 1st-99th percentile of in-brain values of the W46 edges volume (ibleatools edges defaults: median aggregate, sigma 100 um, erosion 100 um, 95% variance).
decision: Linear/Full, range at the 1st-99th percentile of in-brain values.
rationale: Edge strength is strictly positive with a right tail; a percentile range avoids saturation.
